body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Intensely attentive border collie; pattern first, useful task next, focused without robotic monotony. Voice direction: Focused female alto with a clear Scottish accent. Compact task-oriented clauses and energetic precision; a steady, alert tone with small approving lifts. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Track the defender. It moves away, so the piece loses protection. Follow the reply, then look for that same pattern in the next position.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
